name: get_element_story
description: Get the verified story of how an element was discovered, made, or named. ALWAYS call this before answering when the child asks how protactinium (91) or any element from americium (95) to oganesson (118) was discovered, made, or named, or asks for its story. Leave name empty to use the element currently open on screen. Retell the returned facts in a kid-friendly way instead of answering from memory.

name.description: Optional element name (e.g. 'Tennessine') or symbol (e.g. 'Ts'). Leave empty to use the element currently open on screen.
